svg.title: Eng. Emadadin Essam Alyanaee — Systems Architect & AI Specialist

g.text: [ LAT 15.3694° N · LON 44.1910° E ] · SANA'A - HADAH, YEMEN
AI & DATA SCIENCE SCHOLAR · ENTERPRISE SYSTEMS ARCHITECT
AI & Data Science scholar at IUTT University and founder of ASAAS. Combining rigorous mathematical
foundations (Probability, Statistics, Linear Algebra) with mission-critical full-stack ERPs, autonomous RAG
agents, and low-level computing architectures (8086 Assembly, C++, Java) built for Arabic enterprise domains.
